# Emoji Name

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves the name of the Emoji.

## Syntax

~~~~text
emojiName(input: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
emojiName(input: "🚀")
~~~~
